ledger.note: The EIA entry and the existing refs describe a 126 mile line that NextEra's Florida subsidiary built to carry gas to Florida Power and Light power plants. A search summary mentioned Port Dolphin, a proposed LNG import terminal that was never built, but I did not confirm that link in a source I opened. Searches found no source tying this line to LNG exports, so nothing is staged.

The FERC order and a Federal Register notice describe a 5.2 mile lateral that delivers gas to the Okeechobee Clean Energy Center, a Florida Power and Light power plant. The EIA entry gives the same purpose. Searches found no LNG tie.

The FERC docket and a Federal Register notice describe about 38 miles of existing pipe that Florida Southeast Connection bought from Florida Power and Light in 2018. The pipe serves power plants in Martin and Palm Beach Counties. Searches found no LNG tie.

The EIA entry and a 2005 trade press report describe a 55 mile Energy Transfer line in the Barnett Shale area that connects to the North Texas Pipeline in Johnson County. The line serves Texas gas markets. Searches under the pipeline name and Energy Transfer found no source tying it to LNG.
The EIA entry and a 1998 Federal Register notice describe a 53 mile expansion in Colorado that Public Service Company of Colorado built for Colorado gas markets. Searches found no LNG tie.

The existing refs describe a 50 mile, 30 inch offshore gathering and transmission line in the Gulf of Mexico, built in 1997 and now owned by Enbridge. A company story says Enbridge is connected to every Gulf Coast LNG export terminal. That talk is company-wide and does not name this line, so it is not a tie. Nothing is staged.
The only ref is the EIA entry, which describes a 2002 Gas Transmission Northwest expansion with no LNG purpose. A search found no LNG tie.
The existing refs and a FERC notice describe a 24 mile lateral from the Ione Compressor Station to the Carty Generating Station, a power plant in Oregon. Searches found no LNG tie.

The EIA text and the refs describe an expansion that raises imports of Canadian gas through the Kingsgate meter station and serves three gas distributors and a Canadian producer. Searches found no source tying the expansion to LNG exports.

The existing refs describe a 1,377 mile system that carries Canadian gas from Kingsgate, British Columbia to Malin, Oregon, and serves Pacific Northwest and California markets. Searches found no source tying the main line to LNG exports.
The EIA entry and a California regulator document describe a 27 mile line that connects the Gill Ranch gas storage field in Madera County to PG&E's Line 401. Searches found no LNG tie.
The existing refs describe Liberty Utilities' proposed Granite Bridge gas pipeline in New Hampshire, which the company dropped in 2020. Searches found no LNG tie.

The only ref is a Unitil annual report filed with the SEC. Granite State Gas Transmission runs a pipeline between Haverhill, Massachusetts and Portland, Maine. A search found only an old proposed LNG storage and vaporization plant in Wells, Maine that was abandoned. That plant was meant for a local utility, not exports, so nothing is staged.

The EIA entry and a 2015 Bureau of Land Management notice describe a 35 mile expansion in Nevada that serves gas demand near Elko. Searches found no LNG tie. Great Basin also runs a small LNG storage plant near Lovelock that serves winter peak demand, not exports.

The EIA entry and Federal Register notices describe a short looping expansion on the Great Basin system in Nevada. Searches found no LNG export tie. Great Basin also runs a small LNG storage plant near Lovelock that serves winter peak demand, not exports.

The EIA entry and Federal Register notices describe a short looping expansion on the Great Basin system in Nevada, with FERC's environmental assessment issued in late 2025. Searches found no LNG export tie. Great Basin also runs a small LNG storage plant near Lovelock that serves winter peak demand, not exports.

The EIA entry, a 2026 Great Basin fact sheet, and news reports describe a new pipeline in northwest Nevada that would serve shippers in the region, with data centers named as a demand driver. Searches found no LNG export tie. Great Basin also runs a small LNG storage plant near Lovelock that serves winter peak demand, not exports.
The refs describe a relocation of a section of the Great Basin pipeline around the Naval Air Station Fallon in Nevada, under FERC docket CP25-551. Searches found no LNG tie.

The EIA entry and company refs describe the 900 mile Great Basin system across Nevada from the Idaho border to the California border. Searches found no LNG export tie. Great Basin also runs a small LNG storage plant near Lovelock that serves winter peak demand, not exports.

The existing refs describe the Great Lakes system, which carries Canadian gas from Emerson, Manitoba into Michigan and serves upper Midwest markets. Searches found no source tying the line to LNG exports.
